title: Create URL business knowledge source
description: Index a web page as durable, reusable company knowledge that every future agent session can draw on. Use it for authoritative, lasting references the whole team benefits from — public product docs, API references, help-center articles, changelogs, status/policy pages. Do NOT index pages you happened to open while researching the current task, arbitrary search-result links, or pages the user didn't ask to keep — this store is curated team knowledge, not a browsing history. Provide a name and a public HTTP(S) URL; the page is fetched, parsed, chunked, and made searchable. Optionally set a refresh interval so the source is re-fetched automatically. Returns the created source with its processing status (initially "processing" while the URL is fetched in the background).

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Semantic-index state of this source. A `ready` source serves keyword (full-text) search immediately, but semantic search needs a background job to classify and embed its documents, which can take up to an hour. `pending` — at least one document is still awaiting classification or embedding. `completed` — every eligible document has been submitted to the embedding pipeline. `disabled` — the organization has not approved AI data processing, so embeddings never run and search stays keyword-only. Only meaningful while `status` is `ready`.
